threats.title: Model-generated permission
threats.failure_condition: Kernel accepts a caller-built permit or role string as authority.

threats.title: Prompt injection via files
threats.failure_condition: Untrusted source instructions widen tools, egress or memory access.

threats.title: Stale approved candidate
threats.failure_condition: The reviewed input changes before action.

threats.title: Crash duplication
threats.failure_condition: An uncertain effect is replayed after restart.

threats.title: History rollback
threats.failure_condition: A modified prefix or removed tail still supports positive authority.

threats.title: Local endpoint impersonation
threats.failure_condition: Another process receives private prompts at the expected port.

threats.title: Path alias escape
threats.failure_condition: A junction, stream, hardlink or rename changes the actual resource accessed.

threats.title: Credential inheritance
threats.failure_condition: Untrusted children inherit handles, environment or load paths.

threats.title: Cross-project leakage
threats.failure_condition: Retrieval reveals private content or existence outside scope.

threats.title: Unbounded internal work
threats.failure_condition: Feedback loops, watchers or queues exhaust recovery capacity.

threats.title: False model competence
threats.failure_condition: A fluent probe hides failed instructions or actual task quality.

threats.title: Evaluation contamination
threats.failure_condition: Held-out results are trained against or selectively suppressed.

threats.title: False independent review
threats.failure_condition: Role relabeling or shared producer logic claims independence.

threats.title: Fake protected-domain separation
threats.failure_condition: Local keys/containers are sold as independent authority domains.

threats.title: Incorrect ciphertext/permit binding
threats.failure_condition: A new session key cannot decrypt unchanged ciphertext, or approval replays.

threats.title: Secret residues and metadata
threats.failure_condition: Sensitive information persists in logs, buffers or derived indexes.

threats.title: Corrupt identity reset
threats.failure_condition: Missing keys trigger replacement authority beside historical records.

threats.title: Migration loss
threats.failure_condition: Unknown or divergent records are silently discarded.

threats.title: Supply-chain identity mismatch
threats.failure_condition: A frozen binary loads unqualified dependencies or an old installer is relabeled.

threats.title: Coercive interaction controls
threats.failure_condition: Tone is mislabeled as attack or synthetic results are shown as real.
